no growth.outcome: screens smaller than the separation do not carry all of the single-sight-line growth (95%); whether they carry half is not decided

no growth, second sky.outcome: screens smaller than the separation do not carry all of the single-sight-line growth (95%); whether they carry half is not decided

uncorrelated screens, full growth.outcome: the difference between components grows with redshift (t >= +3): screens smaller than the separation carry growth

half the growth.outcome: the difference between components grows with redshift (t >= +3): screens smaller than the separation carry growth
